Again.damage: Damage again, on its own card
Again.healing: Healing again, on its own card

STEADY_ROLLS.Changed: The roll changed meanwhile: try again.
STEADY_ROLLS.CriticalFixed: Critical can't be switched: another module changed this damage after it was built.

AutoDamage.Name: Roll damage automatically
AutoDamage.Hint: For attacks rolled from an item card. On hit: at least one target must be hit.

AutoSaveDamage.Name: Roll save damage automatically
AutoSaveDamage.Hint: For save activities, such as Fireball. Off: roll it with the Damage button once the saves are made, so no one weighs the damage before saving.

UseChoices.Name: Keep the item use dialog for choices
UseChoices.Hint: While item use skips its dialog, still show it when there is something to choose: the spell slot of a leveled spell or of a feature like Divine Smite, how much of a resource to spend (Lay on Hands), or a facility order.

FastForward.Name: Fast-forward rolls
FastForward.Label: Configure
FastForward.MenuHint: Choose which rolls skip their dialog.
FastForward.Hint: Checked rolls skip their dialog. Hold {key} to show it.

TemplateTargets.Name: Target tokens in templates
TemplateTargets.Hint: Once an area of effect is placed, the tokens inside become your targets and the item card's, for its save and damage buttons. Spells that affect only allies or enemies take only those. While placing, faint arrows show who will be targeted.

FollowTargets.Name: Cards follow your targets
FollowTargets.Hint: Changing your targets also changes them on the newest card you made, its attack and its damage, until you make another card. Once damage is applied from it, untargeting removes no one, and new targets stay only if they take damage (or save) before your next card.

Rerolls.Name: Rerolls
Rerolls.Hint: Who can click a die in a roll's breakdown to roll it again. The new result is used; an info card in chat shows the change and can undo it.

Reroll.CannotUndo: This reroll can't be undone: the die has changed since, or the roll can't be changed now.

Save.AllRolled: Your selected tokens already rolled this save. To change a result, reroll its dice.
